title: Conditional Long ADBE — Post-Earnings AI Monetization Confirmation; −30% YTD Reversal Setup
entry: CONDITIONAL — do NOT initiate unless ADBE Q2 FY2026 (reported tonight June 11 after close) meets ALL THREE of: (1) Non-GAAP EPS ≥$5.81 (consensus), (2) Digital Media ARR growth ≥10% YoY, (3) Firefly AI ending ARR shows sequential quarter-over-quarter acceleration. If all three conditions are met, enter on the June 12 first-stabilization session at $240–260 (the gap-up zone expected on a beat). Do NOT enter at the opening spike — wait for the first 30 minutes of June 12 session to confirm stabilization above $240. If any one of the three conditions is missed, do not enter.
stop_loss: $220 daily close (≈12% below the $250 entry midpoint) — implies the earnings beat is being sold by institutional holders who positioned for the event, or that a re-read of the Digital Media ARR trajectory proves weaker than the headline number suggests. A fall back to pre-earnings levels ($235) alone does not trigger the stop — this position is sized to hold through initial volatility.
targets: $275 — full re-rating of the 'AI eats Photoshop' discount on confirmation that Firefly AI ARR is additive; ADBE recovers the June 2 close zone; +10% from entry midpoint $250

$310 — management raises FY2026 Digital Media ARR growth guidance above 12% YoY; Firefly monetization model proves durable; ADBE partially reclaims the AI-software growth premium lost in the −30% YTD re-pricing; +24%

$345 — ADBE removes the AI-deflation overhang from the entire software sector; MSFT, GOOGL, and META re-rate higher on the positive AI-in-software read-through; ADBE re-approaches the $350–380 zone it held before the AI-substitution bear thesis took hold; +38%
catalyst: Adobe reports Q2 FY2026 tonight (June 11) after market close. The stock is −30% YTD from approximately $340 to $235.33 on the thesis that generative AI (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 4, and now Apple's on-device AI) is substituting Photoshop subscriptions rather than augmenting them. The Q2 print is the first time Adobe can definitively show whether its own AI product — Firefly — is generating incremental ARR or merely displacing the legacy Creative Cloud ARR at a lower price point. Consensus is $5.81 non-GAAP EPS / $6.45B revenue. The morning briefing identifies 'Digital Media ARR and Firefly AI monetization are the key read-throughs for all software names' — if the data confirms AI is additive, the negative read-through to MSFT, GOOGL, and META inverts to a positive one.
thesis:
ADBE at $235 is the market pricing a worst-case AI-substitution outcome that has not yet been confirmed by actual revenue data. The bear thesis — that generative AI tools (Midjourney, DALL-E 4, Apple Intelligence image generation) will displace Photoshop and Illustrator subscriptions — is plausible but structurally flawed for the enterprise segment. Enterprise Creative Cloud contracts are renewed annually through procurement departments, not cancelled one user at a time when a new tool appears. The most likely outcome of AI image generation is expansion of the addressable market (more designers, more projects, more output), not contraction — a thesis that Firefly's $250M+ ending ARR (as of Q1 FY2026) already partially supports.

The conditional entry structure is the key discipline here. The morning briefing explicitly says 'avoid pre-earnings positioning' on ADBE — this opportunity follows that guidance. The entry fires ONLY if the three conditions are simultaneously confirmed: (1) EPS beat confirms the core business is intact, (2) Digital Media ARR growth ≥10% YoY confirms subscriptions are growing despite AI competition, and (3) Firefly ARR sequential acceleration confirms the new product is growing faster, not slower. If all three conditions are met, the −30% YTD discount is partially wrong, and the mean reversion path is $275–310 within 2–4 weeks.

The macro read-through from ADBE beats to the broader tape is the second-order catalyst. The morning briefing identifies ADBE as a binary for the entire AI-in-software narrative. A Digital Media ARR growth ≥10% would confirm that AI tools are additive to creative software spending — directly contradicting the AI-deflation narrative that has weighed on MSFT (Azure AI cannibalism concern), GOOGL (search monetization displacement), and META (Reels AI vs. subscription alternatives). A positive ADBE read-through would trigger multiple expansion across the software sector simultaneously, amplifying the price recovery beyond ADBE's individual fundamentals.

The counter-party is the post-earnings seller who argues: (1) ADBE has been in a structural downtrend all year and one beat doesn't reverse it — the AI competition is accelerating, not decelerating; (2) even if Firefly shows ARR growth, the long-term margin structure of a company that must now invest heavily in AI R&D to stay relevant is compressed permanently; (3) in a STEP ASIDE regime with VIX above 18, gap-up bounces in beaten-down tech names are sold into by institutional distribution, not accumulated. These objections are valid — the tight stop at $220 and 2% sizing reflect them.
bull_case: ADBE Q2 FY2026 beats all three conditions: EPS $6.00+, Digital Media ARR growth 12%+ YoY, Firefly AI ending ARR +$80M+ quarter-over-quarter. Stock gaps to $265–275 on June 12 open. Management raises FY2026 Digital Media ARR guidance by 2–3 percentage points. MSFT, GOOGL, and META trade up 2–4% on the AI-additive read-through. ADBE stabilizes at $260–270 on Day 1 and extends toward $310 over the following two weeks as the 'AI eats software' bear thesis is systematically unwound.
bear_case: ADBE misses on Digital Media ARR (growth below 8% YoY) — the most feared scenario — or Firefly ARR shows deceleration quarter-over-quarter. Stock gaps down 12–18% from $235.33 to $195–210 on June 12. The AI-substitution narrative is validated; the read-through to MSFT, GOOGL, META is negative; the software sector selloff extends through the week. In this scenario, the conditional entry is never triggered and no capital is at risk — the value of the conditional structure.
invalidation: Entry condition not met: any one of EPS <$5.81 OR Digital Media ARR growth <10% YoY OR Firefly ARR deceleration (position never initiated). OR $220 daily close on any session while held (thesis failed post-entry). OR management guides FY2026 revenue below $25.4B (below current consensus trajectory), suggesting structural deterioration beyond the AI bear case.

outcome.outcome_label: Thesis broken — CFO departure; entry zone $240-260 never reached
outcome.note: ADBE Q2 FY2026 beat all quantitative conditions (EPS $5.96 vs $5.81 consensus, Firefly AI ARR tripled), but CFO Dan Durn announced departure to Marvell effective June 15 AH on June 11. Stock opened June 12 at $208.98 — well below the $240-260 conditional entry zone — invalidating the trade. Dual C-suite vacancy (CFO departing + ongoing CEO search) removed the entry trigger entirely. Position never initiated; no capital at risk. Return: 0.0%.
